results.content: # A whiplash election year enters its final stretch as Trump holds wild cards. The political landscape in the U.S. is volatile as the final midterm of President Donald Trump’s presidency approaches. President Donald Trump gestures in the Oval Office of the White House, Thursday, Aug. 27, 2026, in Washington. WASHINGTON — In the earliest days of this election cycle, the U.S. wasn’t at war with Iran . The East Wing of the White House was still standing and the Kennedy Center wasn’t threatened with demolition. Artificial intelligence data centers weren’t bipartisan shorthand for the tech sector’s excess. Democratic socialists were largely confined to the outer edges of political discourse. Lake
